finding: Draft PR #2453 read-only census (baseball 2024-2026, prod Cosmos, paginated, no cross-partition COUNT/GROUP BY): 22 (setKey, cardNumber-prefix, year) groups / 3,265 pairs where a checklist-grade card_catalog row sits at a :no-auto id for a cardNumber prefix already registered AUTOGRAPH-ONLY (global AUTO_ONLY_CARDNUMBER_PREFIX or the per-product SCOPED_AUTO_ONLY_PREFIXES table), beside a checklist-grade :auto twin at the same (cardNumber, parallel, printRun). R-0927d (Drew, 2026-09-27 ~02:50Z): for these auto-only inserts a checklist-grade :no-auto row is a minting error (the checklistinsider-layout-mints-autos-unsigned defect) -- sales sitting on it move to the checklist-grade :auto row (this list, step 1), then the emptied :no-auto twin is retired separately by relocate-catalog-rows-by-list once this list has moved every sale off it (step 2, not part of this PR). No expectedSales is set on any entry: only 110 of #2453 own 3,265 pairs got a live sales-at-id.cjs DUAL check at census time (2026-09-26/27); the remaining 3,155 carry sampledOnly placeholders copied from their groups own sampled max (including many whose sampled count was 0) -- these are stale by construction, so the live zero-sales gate inside repoint-sales-by-list.cjs decides at REPORT/APPLY time, never this list. SS- (2025 panini-prizm) is excluded per #2453: all 1,409 SS- rows are DERIVED on both sides, never checklist-grade, so this defect does not apply to it. Football/basketball 2024-2026 (#2453 09-27 extension) found zero groups -- baseball is the whole scope. REPORT-only until Drew rules on this list; APPLY is not authorized by the PR that adds this file.
